name: bg-sliding-stripes
title: Sliding-Stripes Background — counter-sliding photo bands
description: Seamless looping background: one image cut into stripes that slide in opposite directions (odd/even counter-phase), shearing apart and realigning; the realigned moment is the loop point. 1.3x overscan on the slide axis means stripe edges never leave the frame. Horizontal bands on landscape, vertical on portrait. 10s loop, cut anywhere. Landscape 16:9 twin of bg-sliding-stripes-portrait.

variables.label: Image
variables.description: Image sliced into counter-sliding stripes (URL or project asset path)

variables.label: Stripes
variables.description: Number of stripes along the cut axis (6-24)

variables.label: Axis
variables.description: Stripe orientation and slide direction (auto = horizontal landscape / vertical portrait)

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Full slide oscillations per 10s loop (integer, keeps the loop seamless) (1-3)

variables.label: Max shift
variables.description: Peak slide distance in px; clamped to 40% of the overscan slack so edges never show (20-300)

variables.label: Scrim
variables.description: Black overlay strength for text readability 0-1
